title: ever JUNIPER|Bodycon Sequin Slit Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
The sequin details catch the light just right, while the gathered waist adds definition without clinging. The slit brings movement to the long skirt and lets your shoes have a moment too. Whether you're a guest, part of the bridal party, or showing up as mother of the bride, this gown gives you presence without feeling overdone.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
